messages.content:
Hello! I'm AURA, your AI-powered Medical Health Operating System. I'm here to assist clinicians and patients with health-related questions, symptom analysis, medication guidance, and clinical reasoning.

Please remember that I'm an AI, not a healthcare provider. For any medical concerns, symptoms, diagnosis, or treatment decisions, always consult a qualified healthcare professional who can evaluate your individual situation and provide safe, personalized care.

How can I help you today? Whether you have a health question, are looking to understand symptoms, need medication information, or want to explore clinical reasoning—I'm here to support you within those boundaries.
